Name: AzureDragon's Tame Rocks
Author: azuredragon113
Description:
[b][size=4]Get ready to rock[/size][/b]
Marnie has a new critter in stock!  This mod adds living rocks as a [b]coop[/b] animal.  They like a little space, so your farm must have at least a Big Coop for them to live in.  Let them outside and they'll dig up occasional treasures that get better as you befriend them (stone > coal > gemstones).

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*] Download and install the main ZIP from this mod
[*] Start up the game and see Marnie at her shop!
[/list]To remove the mod, just delete it from your mods folder.
